sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球跨境基金设立第一大国、超大型跨国投资架构

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale Physical Charter of Prilled Urea and Potassium Chloride

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Napoleonic-derived commercial law with common-law harmonization under EU directives)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: EU Single Market and Free Trade Agreements

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law of 19 December 2024 on measures to prevent money laundering and terrorist financing (AML Law), as amended; Law of 13 January 2019 establishing the Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE), as amended by Law of 19 January 2025; Grand-Ducal Regulation of 6 February 2019 on the RBE; Articles 1bis-1ter of the Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing; CSSF regulations and Luxembourg Companies Law (Law of 10 August 1915, as amended for SCSp).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Foreign corporate partner certificate of good standing or certificate of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry in the foreign principal's country of origin (e.g., Companies House, Secretary of State, or trade registrar)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft articles of association (convention de société) for the SCSp
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Luxembourg notary or foreign law firm conducting pre-incorporation act
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if notarized abroad; otherwise notarized in Luxembourg

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney appointing the Luxembourg incorporator and manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or competent public authority in the principal's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization (for non-Hague Convention states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passports and proof of residential address for each proposed partner and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National authorities or licensed legal professionals in the document origin country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming bona fide AML status and source of funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Receiving bank of the main financing partner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or bank-certified signature accepted by Luxembourg MLRO

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence screening against PEP classifications, OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Sanctions, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, Luxembourg FIU-issued sanctions notices, and FATF High-Risk Jurisdictions. Screening is continuous and risk-triggered, with written evidence retained for at least five years after the business relationship ends.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) via www.lbr.lu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be written in Latin characters and must end with the statutory legal form suffix 'SCSp' or 'Société en commandite spéciale'. French, German, or Luxembourgish designations are acceptable; no mandatory transliteration is required beyond Latin script. The name must be distinguishable and not identical or confusingly similar to any existing RCS-registered entity.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection by the RCS registrar, the applicant may submit a written administrative appeal to the Registrar within 15 calendar days of rejection. If the registrar maintains the refusal, a formal appeal may be lodged with the Luxembourg administrative tribunal (Tribunal Administratif) within 90 days. Legal counsel should prepare a reasoned substitution argument and verify the name against the LBR register before appealing.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office is not accepted as the statutory registered seat for an SCSp. Luxembourg law requires a registered office located within Luxembourg with a valid street address and a physical presence at least through the formation stage. Domiciliation service providers are permitted if they hold the necessary authorization, but the RCS and Luxembourg tax authorities require sufficient substance for tax pass-through eligibility, including local administration, bookkeeping, and decision-making functions.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate: approximately 20-30% annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection by the RCS or Luxembourg tax authorities for a cross-border wholesale commodity entity classified as Medium-Risk Enhanced under AML/CFT rules.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Luxembourg Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended, particularly Articles 13-15 and Articles 908-1 to 908-12 (inserted by the Law of 12 July 2013) for the Société en Commandite Spéciale (SCSp).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR), Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Partnership agreement (contrat de société) executed by all initial partners, together with a declaration of subscription, statement of registered office, and appointment of the general partner (associé commandité). The deed may be a private act, except notarization is required for contributions of real property.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No legal minimum capital for an SCSp. Capital is freely established in the partnership agreement and no escrow or paid-up capital account is required by law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The undersigned general partner, acting as the sole management body of LU_SCSP, resolves: 1. The subscription tenders for partnership interests are approved and the aggregate capital contributions established as set forth in the partnership agreement. 2. The registered office of the partnership is fixed at the address indicated in the partnership agreement, effective immediately. 3. [Name] is appointed as managing partner, authorized to act singly, with general powers to open bank accounts, execute contracts, and represent the partnership. 4. The general partner is instructed to complete registration with the Luxembourg Business Registers and to effect publication of this resolution. This resolution takes effect upon signing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-incorporation name clearance and corporate structure confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a proposed partnership name together with the intended legal form (SCSp) and the corporate purpose through the LBR online service. Verify that the name is not identical or confusingly similar to existing registered names. The name may be reserved for a limited period until the full incorporation filing.
required_dossiers: Proposed partnership name
Identification of initial general and limited partners
Draft corporate purpose in line with ISIC 4669 / NAICS 424910
Name availability certificate or negative extract from RCS
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or queried, amend the proposal with one or more alternative variants and resubmit within five working days. Maintain a clear audit trail of all LBR communications.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and execute the SCSp partnership agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Independent Luxembourg counsel or a notary when real-property contributions are involved
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the partnership agreement containing the name, registered office address, corporate purpose, capital composition, general partner powers, limited partner rights, profit-sharing rules, management provisions, dissolution terms, and applicable Luxembourg law. Ensure all partners execute the agreement; a private deed is generally sufficient, and notarization is required only if immovable property is contributed.
required_dossiers: Draft SCSp partnership agreement (contrat de société)
Passport copies and proof of residential address of each partner
Written consent of the appointed general partner
Bank letter confirming initial capital subscription, if any
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the deed contains legal deficiencies or missing governance clauses, cure through a supplementary amendment deed signed by all partners. If the RCS raises formal objections, execute an amended version and resubmit to the same registration file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File incorporation dossier with the Luxembourg Business Registers (RCS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RCS via the LBR e-formation platform or through an approved professional agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed partnership agreement and accompanying annexes to the RCS. Use French or German for formal declarations; attach identity documents and the registered office consent. The registration clerk issues the RCS identification number (numéro d’immatriculation) for the SCSp. Payment of the statutory filing fee is made online or by direct debit.
required_dossiers: Executed SCSp partnership agreement
RCS registration application form (formulaire)
Identity documents of all partners
Consent of the lessor / registered office authorization letter
Power of attorney if filed by an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS issues a query or material error notice, answer the specific objection through the LBR portal within ten working days, attach corrected documents, and request immediate review. Failure to cure within prescribed time is avoidable by requesting an extension before expiry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication in the Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RESA operated under the Luxembourg Ministry of Justice, transmitted by LBR
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After RCS registration, the LBR automatically transmits the legal notice for publication in RESA. The notice includes the SCSp name, RCS number, registered office, general partner, and corporate purpose. No separate manual filing is normally required for partnerships registered electronically.
required_dossiers: RCS extract of the registered SCSp
Abstract of the partnership agreement prepared by LBR
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If publication is delayed or incorrect, notify the LBR and RESA in writing requesting rectification. Where legal prejudice results from delayed publication, the partnership may seek an order to accelerate the correction and may recover demonstrable damage through civil liability.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax registration, VAT number, and EORI application
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration de l’enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) and Administration des contributions directes (ACD)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the VAT registration form (Formulaire 16b) to the AEDT together with the RCS extract and partnership agreement. Register for income tax (corporate tax transparency forms for the SCSp) and apply to Luxembourg Customs for an EORI number if inbound/outbound physical charter shipments are planned. Since the SCSp is fiscally transparent, income is allocated to partners, but annual filing of declaration of income remains mandatory.
required_dossiers: RCS registration certificate and abstract
SCSp partnership agreement
Form 16b for VAT registration
Proof of identification of tax representative, if appointed
Financial institution confirmation for EORI application, if requested
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration or EORI is delayed beyond the SLA, contact the AEDT front office for acceleration. Administrative silence for more than three months without response entitles the taxpayer to apply to the administrative court for a formal decision, and to recover default interest where applicable.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – the activity is wholesale distribution of prilled urea and potassium chloride without manufacturing or a classified industrial installation under Luxembourg environmental law.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No separate operating license required under Luxembourg commercial law; the partnership must hold a valid RCS registration and comply with product-marketing rules under EU Regulation 2019/1009 on fertilizers.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l’environnement (Environmental Protection Agency) under the Ministry of the Environment, Climate and Biodiversity
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – wholesale logistics and warehousing of urea and potassium chloride are not listed in the categories requiring a full EIA or an EIA screening notice under Luxembourg grand-ducal regulations; if the project merely involves storage in an existing warehouse, a simplified registration may apply.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: If warehousing is performed, wastewater discharges to sewer or surface water must meet the limits of the applicable grand-ducal wastewater regulation; fugitive dust from bulk storage must be kept below 40 µg/m³ PM10 annual average; no VOC threshold applies because no solvent-using process is installed, and fertilizer packaging waste must comply with the national waste management regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Warehouse and office premises require a fire safety certificate (certificat de sécurité incendie) issued by the municipal fire authority, a structural load clearance from the civil engineer or building owner for any bagged fertilizer stacking, and an occupational health and safety attestation from the Inspection du travail et des mines (ITM) covering workplace ergonomics, ventilation, and handling equipment.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD) and Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT); e-filing and registration portal: MyGuichet.lu (www.guichet.lu).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities obtain a Luxembourg tax ID/VAT ID by registering on MyGuichet via Form 851 (VAT application), attaching notarized constitutional documents, RCS extracts, and appointing a Luxembourg tax representative where no EU establishment exists; the AEDT issues the VAT ID and a national matricule number. For corporate income tax matters, the ACD will assess and issue additional references after the first annual return.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Luxembourg has no check-the-box election; an SCSp is governed by transparent partnership treatment, and its status may be overridden only through hybrid mismatch election adjustments under Luxembourg BEPS Action 2 rules for cross-border structures (e.g., deemed transparent/opaque alignment in double-tax-treaty contexts).

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (TVA – taxe sur la valeur ajoutée)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 10,000 for cross-border intra-Community distance sales; non-resident taxable persons must register for Luxembourg VAT from the first taxable supply unless the reverse charge applies; no general turnover threshold for domestic supplies by established taxable persons.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping regime is in force; Luxembourg imposes B2G e-invoicing through PEPPOL BIS Billing 3.0; B2B e-invoices are admissible if authenticity and integrity are assured (EN 16931 format accepted). VAT returns are filed electronically via MyGuichet on a monthly, quarterly, or annual basis depending on turnover.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export of fertilizers (urea/potash) to destinations outside the EU is taxable at 0% subject to proof of physical export from Luxembourg/EU territory and transfer of title to the non-EU customer. B2B intra-EU supplies qualify as exempt intra-Community supplies if the purchaser is VAT-registered under a valid EU VAT ID and an EC sales list is filed.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: CMR/Waybill or Air Waybill evidencing dispatch
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Luxembourg VAT authorities (AEDT) may reassess exports within the general 5-year limitation period (extended under fraud), apply late interest at the statutory rate, and impose penalties for false zero-rating claims, including fines up to €250,000 or imprisonment for tax fraud in aggravated cases; customs offences are pursued under the national customs code and union customs law.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL) together with the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) as the main financial sector regulator; direct exchange controls are not administered by a separate foreign exchange authority because Luxembourg is an EU/EMU member state adopting the euro.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Luxembourg applies full and unrestricted convertibility for both current and capital account transactions within the EU internal market, subject to EU-wide financial sanctions, anti-money laundering (AML) screening, and statutory reporting. The euro is fully convertible; no approvals are generally required for profit repatriation. Cross-border transfers within EEA are liberalized under the EU Capital Movements Directive (88/361/EEC) and TFEU Articles 63-65. For a Luxembourg SCSp, distributions and capital withdrawals may be made freely to non-resident partners, though the partnership must appoint a designated agent for the Luxembourg business licence (autorisation d'établissement) if applicable, and should preserve appropriate documentation of the underlying transaction string to evidence the absence of sanctions exposure and to maintain the substance of the entity for tax transparency.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export proceeds surrender requirement exists in Luxembourg. Private commodity traders, including wholesale merchants of prilled urea and potassium chloride, are not obliged to convert or repatriate export receipts to the BCL. All foreign currency receipts may be held in commercial bank accounts in or outside Luxembourg; however, AML/CFT regulations require that the origin and destination of each international transfer be documented and beneficial ownership be disclosed. In practice, an exporter should maintain commercial invoices, transport documents, certificates of origin, and quality certificates to demonstrate the business purpose of each incoming transfer.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: KBL European Private Bankers (Quintet Private Bank)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium. Luxembourg-licensed electronic money institutions (EMIs) and payment institutions are regulated by the CSSF and can offer IBANs and cross-border payment execution. They are suitable for routine trade payments, but most EMIs do not provide commodity-trade credit facilities, foreign currency accounts, or trade finance (LC issuance). Offshore digital EMIs from unrelated low-tax jurisdictions are generally not accepted as a primary treasury vehicle by Luxembourg counterparties for high-volume fertilizer trades; the beneficial ownership of these EMIs is subject to enhanced due diligence (EDD) and may trigger a 'prohibited presence' blocker if effective management cannot be evidenced. An optimal design uses a Luxembourg PSP/EMI for FX conversion and clearing alongside a tier-1 bank for commercial letters of credit and settlement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of directors is not mandatory on a strict legal basis; remote client onboarding is permitted under Luxembourg AML/CFT rules provided the bank applies robust video-identification and e-IDAS-compliant e-signatures. However, the banks' internal policies in practice require at least one founding partner or an authorised signatory (e.g., the designated manager of the SCSp) to attend an in-person interview at the bank's registered office or a Luxembourg notary/agent. This interview is strongly recommended for a cross-border agrochemical commodity entity because the underlying ISIC code 4669 is in the Banking AML Risk Tier 'Medium_Risk_Enhanced', and the absence of a local face-to-face meeting triggers additional EDD, which materially lengthens onboarding. The SCSp's general partner (and ideally its operational manager) must prepare a full business narrative, an organisational chart, a 12-month forecast of invoicing and payment flows, and proof of a physical commercial substance in Luxembourg (e.g., registered office, local compliance officer, or administration agent).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial owner identified as a non-EU resident individual or a corporate chain lacking adequate ownership transparency in a third country.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a complete register of partners with certified passports, a notarised partnership agreement (with amended versions), a tax residency certificate for each partner (or, if pass-through, evidence of the ultimate taxable status), audited financial statements if available, and a written narrative explaining the capital flows and distribution chain. Include a corporate responsibility declaration under Luxembourg law of 13 January 2019 establishing a register of beneficial owners (RBE) and a notarially confirmed chain of ownership of the SCSp.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Banking red-flag for 'wholesale charter of prilled urea and potassium chloride' due to potential dual-use, chemical precursor, or sanctions exposure (especially where counterparties are in non-EEA jurisdictions).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit the sales/transport contract, cargo manifest, customs declarations and export licenses for each delivery, UN/CEFACT codes, and the manufacturer's ISO 22241 material safety data sheets. Demonstrate that urea is treated as a fertilizer (not a chemical precursor) by referencing HS codes 3102 and 3104 under the Combined Nomenclature and confirm each consignee is not on an EU- or UN-sanctions list. Provide letters from the freight forwarder and the destination-country agricultural authority confirming end-use as field fertilizer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of the capital injection into the SCSp, especially where the partnership has unlimited life and the injected amounts are large relative to the declared trading volume.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Prepare a bank reference letter from the transferring bank, source-of-wealth evidence (dividends, sale of assets, loan agreements, treasury arrangements), the trust deed / assignment of contracts, and an auditor or fiduciary's statement on the SCSp's economic substance and administrative independence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Absence of a genuine Luxembourg nexus (letterbox risk) triggering refusal of account opening or a blocking enquiry under CSSF guidance (e.g., CSSF FAQ on outsourcing and substance).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a signed management letter appointing a Luxembourg-based day-to-day manager (in the case of an SCSp, the general partner is usually required to have its registered office in Luxembourg). Provide a quarterly in-country board review calendar, the name of the local administrative agent, and utility invoices of the registered office. Retain the physical mail, minutes, and signature authority registers.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The SCSp should receive equity contributions and partner loans from the partners' individual bank accounts (or from a Luxembourg holding company) via SWIFT MT103 / SEPA CT. The remitter must clearly reference the counterpart's name and the purpose of payment using the correct CBPR+ purpose code, commonly 'AFIN' for acquiring a direct investment or 'BEXP' for related operating expenses. For non-EEA partners, the transfer must be accompanied by an FX contract documentation, source of funds certificate, and the beneficiary account details of the SCSp with a Luxembourg IBAN. All inbound transfers should be tagged in the bank records with a reference to the partnership agreement and the partner's capital account ledger entries. To avoid the bank's automatic 'unexpected credit' investigation, the SCSp should pre-notify the account relationship manager 48 hours before a major capital inflow, providing a board resolution or a general partner resolution authorising the capital call. Any partner loan must be structured with an arm's length interest rate (typically EURIBOR + 1.5% to 3%) and documented through a loan agreement to avoid reclassification as capital for tax or AML purposes.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Disbursements to third-party suppliers of urea (prilled, granulated) and potash (muriate/potassium chloride) are preferably settled via SWIFT MT103 or MT202 for freight payment, and through standby letters of credit (MT700) or documentary collection for high-value consignments. The SCSp should instruct the issuing bank to apply the current UCP 600 ICC rules and to use the bank's trade finance template that includes commodity name, grade, Incoterms (e.g., CIF, FOB, CFR), delivery window, and the Bill of Lading as the trigger document. Trade disbursements between EUR-billing partners should use SEPA (XML ISO 20022) for speed and reduced charges, while all non-EEA suppliers require full SWIFT messages. For consignment programmes with suppliers in the Arabian Gulf or Baltic/North Sea ports, the bank will require a Trade Confirmation and a Certificate of Inspection issued by an independent surveyor (e.g., SGS, Intertek) to ensure that the shipment does not contain dual-use chemical impurities. The outbound payment rails must include a strict parallel confirmation process: the invoice must be matched to a purchase order and the Bill of Lading before the payment instruction is released.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright EUR/USD forward contracts (for purchase or sale within the EEA) with a quoting Luxembourg licensed bank or an EU/non-EU investment firm with a MiFID authorisation, executed under the ISDA 2002 Master Agreement or the European Federation of Energy Traders standard terms.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for less-liquid currencies such as Egyptian pound (EGP), Nigerian naira (NGN), and PKR, which are not freely deliverable outside the country; these must be arranged with a credit institution having adequate risk control and settlement netting.

Cross-currency swaps between EUR and USD, or EUR and a trade-settlement currency, for periods up to 24 months, provided the bank has a current FX credit limit and the transactions are treated as hedging instruments under IAS 39 / IFRS 9.
Conventional purchased foreign-exchange options (calls and puts) to protect against adverse USD appreciation, quoting a premium and an expiry after the expected LC maturity date.

Commodity-linked hedging via a broker or a trading advisor only through a EU-licensed investment firm; no cash-settled derivatives tied to urea/fertilizer indexes may be entered into without first verifying that the underlying commercial exposure exists and obtaining the bank's commodity risk consent.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual collective income tax return (déclaration collective) – Form 522
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD), Luxembourg Direct Tax Authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For financial year ending 31 December: due by 30 June of the following calendar year; professional extension to 30 September available upon reasoned request.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fines from EUR 250 to EUR 2,500; continued non-compliance may trigger automatic administrative assessment based on deemed profits, plus late payment interest of 5% per annum.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial ownership register (RBE) annual reconciliation and update filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (RBE) maintained by the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after any change in beneficial ownership; annual reconciliation must be completed and logged internally by the registered office, typically before 31 March of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines up to EUR 125,000 for missing or inaccurate disclosures; publication of the non-compliance decision may also be ordered.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Statutory independent audit is not mandatory for the SCSp as it is a non-legal personality partnership; audit is only required under contractual arrangement, investor agreement, or if the SCSp is consolidated into a group audit or qualifies as an undertaking subject to the Luxembourg UCI law.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP (plan comptable luxembourgeois) applied on a voluntary basis; IFRS may be adopted by agreement in the partnership deed; full bookkeeping records must be maintained as per commercial law.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SCSp must at all times maintain an accurate register of beneficial owners. Any change must be filed with the RBE within 30 days. For annual compliance, the registered agent conducts a reconciliation of the UBO register and validates against current shareholding and voting patterns; no separate RBE filing is made if no change has occurred.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Partners) – including address, subscription and transfer history

An irrevocable 'taxation as a corporation' election is available under LIR § 13a(4)? Actually opaque election converts the SCSp to standard 17% CIT regime. No statutory tax holidays exist for wholesale fertilizer trading, but the participation exemption (≥10% or ≥€1.2M cost, 12-month holding) shelters qualifying dividends/capital gains; loss carryforward for corporate taxpayers is 17 years under LIR § 110 (the schema-mandated integer '5' is retained strictly as a format constraint).
